meta.name: discord-create-channel
meta.description: Create new channels in Discord guilds/servers via the Discord API. Use this skill when the user wants to create text channels, voice channels, announcement channels, or categories in a Discord server.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Discord 服务器中创建文字、语音或公告频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动在 Discord 服务器中创建频道
copy.tagline_en: Create text, voice, or announcement channels in Discord servers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate channel creation in Discord servers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Discord API 在服务器中创建文本、语音、公告、阶段频道或分类，并验证名称、权限，返回频道 ID 和链接。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建 Discord 频道时触发，例如创建文本频道、语音频道等。

say.text: 帮我在Discord服务器里创建一个叫「general-chat」的文本频道。
say.note: Claude 会验证名称并请求创建，成功后返回频道信息。

say.text: 为我的服务器新建一个语音频道「voice-lounge」，限制10人。
say.note: Claude 会设置用户上限并创建频道。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can create text, voice, announcement, stage channels or categories in a Discord server via the Discord API. It validates channel names, checks permissions, and returns the channel ID and URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create a Discord channel, such as text, voice, or announcement channels.

say_en.text: Create a text channel named 'general-chat' in my Discord server.
say_en.note: Claude validates the name and creates the channel, returning its info.

say_en.text: Make a voice channel 'voice-lounge' with a limit of 10 users.
say_en.note: Claude sets the user limit and creates the channel.
